Subject: Lanmore Roofing - Submission

Hi Avery,

Thanks for thinking of us for Lanmore Roofing. I appreciate the complete submission.

Unfortunately, we'll need to decline this opportunity. Roofing contractors fall outside our current appetite due to the specialized nature of the exposure and elevated risk profile.

I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty contractor market, one that actively writes roofing risks and would be better positioned to provide competitive terms.

Please don't hesitate to reach out with future submissions that might be a better fit for our appetite.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
